subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After the persistence race is repaired, should OpenClaw keep both the maintenance-specific timeout config and the generic synchronous command-queue timeout callback as permanent contracts?
rationale: The bug and narrow lifecycle repair are concrete, but adding an operator setting and a shared queue ordering hook requires owner intent under the repository's compatibility and config-surface policy.

options.title: Keep both contracts
options.body: Repair persistence ownership, retain the opt-in setting and queue hook, and lock their upgrade and ordering semantics with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Reuse compaction timeout policy
options.body: Bound maintenance through the existing compaction safety budget and avoid adding the maintenance-specific setting or generic callback.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle redesign
options.body: Defer the PR until context-engine cancellation and transcript persistence ownership have a broader canonical contract.

recommendation.title: Keep both contracts
recommendation.body: Repair persistence ownership, retain the opt-in setting and queue hook, and lock their upgrade and ordering semantics with focused tests and docs.
